[center][size=4][color=#ffff00]这个农场像是一个隐秘的角落，有着绝对的私密空间。

The layout has been pre planned, with a planting area on the left and a livestock area on the right of the farmhouse.
Three exits together for convenient travel.
The new game will generate 5 fruit trees.
Default replacement of standard farm.[/color]
